_provenance.what: THE L2 ORACLE INPUT — all 240 published spell rows, captured VERBATIM from the live assets host. A test reading this reads the shipped data sheet, not a hand-written approximation of it (the codec-fixture law: an oracle must not be authored by the model it judges).
_provenance.verbatim: Every level, effect, crit_effect, range, ap_cost and role is byte-for-byte the published row — effects keep their on-chain numeric kind/element/target_filter encoding, which is exactly what makes them an oracle.
_provenance.redacted: object_id ONLY, and MECHANICALLY: row N carries `0x` + N zero-padded to 4 digits. The published rows carry live deployment ids, and pinning those in source is what the hardcoded chain-id gate forbids. The value proves nothing here — the #931 fix re-keys decks, spell levels and templates onto whatever object_id the row carries (fight_start.js cast_id_of), so a stand-in of the same shape exercises the identical id-space path.
_provenance.regenerate: The stand-in is a pure function of row order: rows[i].object_id === 0x + String(i).padStart(4, 0). Re-fetch the source, re-apply, diff — any other field changing is a corpus change, not a fixture edit.
_provenance.layout: One row per line so a corpus diff reads row-by-row.
